record.title: Pacaraima anti-migrant protest blockade of international crossing, August2018
record.scope: Deliberate protest blockade at named international crossing/BR174; selective and intermittent movement not quantified.
record.direction: Anti-migrant obstruction; detailed direction contested between expulsion accounts and parliamentary wording about preventing return.
record.movement: Venezuelan migrants targeted; effects on goods and other nationalities unresolved.
record.exceptions: Venezuelans fleeing Brazil crossed during the episode; cannot infer total two-way closure.
record.enforcement: Reuters reports government video showing protesters blocking sole crossing; parliamentary notice attributes temporary BR174 blockade to Army account.
record.consequences: Venezuelans fled Brazil during attacks; avoid attributing all displacement to blockade alone.
record.relationship: Distinct from R2-AM-006 judicial suspension and held R11-AM-L003 July19 protest. Related service-closure lead R14-AM-L001 is not the same mechanism.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources; no present-status inference.
record.context: Anti-migrant violence following an alleged robbery; allegation not independently adjudicated.
record.uncertainty: Exact start clock, lifting time and continuous scope unestablished. Parliamentary direction wording conflicts with expulsion narrative. AFP reports normal operation by Sunday August19, not an exact reopening. Separate reception-office closure August18–19 is held for scope and not merged.

historical.duration_note: Not calculated; scoped continuity and exact endpoint unresolved.
